text:
Taylor: Creating a short action-tracking thread for the KV-cache OOM follow-ups. Goal: assign owners, ETAs, and a lightweight sync cadence.
Maya: I can own allocation profiling + artifacts.
Samir: I'll run eviction-policy experiments and capture eviction/resident metrics.
Eli: I'll test jemalloc/bg-compaction and measure fragmentation/CPU.
Taylor: Initial actions:
  - Maya: deterministic+sampling profiles, flamegraphs, heap snapshots from replay. ETA: Tue EOD.
  - Samir: LRU/segmented/TTL eviction runs on staging, record hit-rate, evictions/s, resident. ETA: Thu.
  - Eli: enable jemalloc background purge every 60s on a canary, measure p99 and CPU delta. ETA: Mon.
  - infra-bot: create tickets and attach last-night logs/traces; add ephemeral throttles for noisy tests.
infra-bot: Tickets created INF-3301 (alloc-profiling), INF-3302 (eviction-experiments), INF-3303 (gc-compaction). Links: https://jira.redwood/INF-3301 etc.
oncall: Reminder to set temporary alert thresholds to avoid paging SRE during experiments.
Maya: I'll run: `python tools/replay.py --trace traces/repro-2026-03-22 --max-time 3600 --out alloc.trace` then `flamegraph.pl alloc.fold > alloc.svg`. Will attach to INF-3301. Sampling+snapshots noted.
Samir: Plan: start with `segment_bytes=65536 max_fill=0.8`, then `segment_bytes=32768 max_fill=0.6` if needed; will track latency regressions.
Eli: Commands: `jeprof --text /tmp/prof.heap > jemalloc.txt` and `jemalloc-config --stats` after runs. Will canary and report.
Taylor: Let's do daily 1-line updates on each ticket. Close or escalate by Apr 12.
Maya: Ack, posting flamegraph Tue.
Samir: Staging results Wed.
Eli: Canary Mon.
Taylor: I'll schedule a recurring Thu 09:00 PST x3 for progress check-ins.
infra-bot: Calendar invite "KV frag remediation sync" created for Thu 09:00 PST, 3 occurrences.
oncall: I'll add a safety throttle to staging during tests.
Maya: Note sampling misses sub-ms allocations; will include full snapshots where feasible.
Samir: If eviction reduces resident but increases miss latency, we'll prototype hotset pinning.
Taylor: Thanks. Post blockers here and tag me.
